headerDisplay:
Tuya without developer account for Homebridge

This plugin uses Home Assistant-style Tuya QR Cloud Authentication. It does not ask for Tuya IoT Access ID, Access Secret, cloud project, username, or password. Open the plugin settings, enter your Tuya User Code, generate the QR code, scan it with the Tuya Smart or Smart Life app, then save.
footerDisplay: Note: If authentication is cleared or expires, generate a new QR code from this settings screen.

userCode.title: Tuya User Code
userCode.description: The User Code from the Tuya Smart or Smart Life mobile app. This is the only required cloud authentication value.

homeWhitelist.title: Home Whitelist
homeWhitelist.description: Optional. Restrict discovery to specific Tuya home IDs after authentication.

enableAdaptiveLighting.title: Enable Adaptive Lighting for eligible lights
enableAdaptiveLighting.description: Optional. Enables HomeKit Adaptive Lighting only for Tuya lights that expose both brightness and real white color-temperature controls. RGB-only lights and dimmer plugs are skipped.

preserveHomeKitNames.title: Preserve names changed in HomeKit
preserveHomeKitNames.description: Recommended. Prevents Homebridge restarts from replacing names you assigned to individual services in Apple Home, especially multi-gang switches and outlets. Explicit switchNames overrides still take priority.

syncHomebridgeNamesToHomeKit.title: Sync Homebridge names to Apple Home
syncHomebridgeNamesToHomeKit.description: Recommended. Makes the names shown in Homebridge Accessories authoritative for HomeKit service names on every restart. This applies to all devices/services, including multi-gang switches, outlets, fans, blinds, and sensors.

deviceOverrides.title: Device Overrides
deviceOverrides.description: Optional advanced overrides. Use this only if a discovered device needs a custom category, schema mapping, or to be hidden/unbridged.

category.title: Custom Type / Category Override
category.description: Optional. Force a device to use a specific Tuya category handler. Special category overrides are isolated by detected device type so Pet Feeder, Blind/Window Covering, AC, and channel-name settings cannot bleed into unrelated devices.

preserveHomeKitNames.title: Preserve HomeKit names for this device
preserveHomeKitNames.description: Optional per-device override of the global setting. True preserves names changed in Apple Home; false lets the plugin reapply generated/default names on restart.

switchNames.title: Multi-switch channel names
switchNames.description: Optional explicit names keyed by Tuya schema code. These names take priority over preserved HomeKit names and generated defaults. Example: {"switch_1":"Coffee Machine","switch_2":"Kitchen Lamp","switch_usb1":"USB Ports"}.

adaptiveLighting.title: Adaptive Lighting Override
adaptiveLighting.description: Optional per-device override. Use enabled=true to force-enable for this device, or enabled=false to disable it even when global Adaptive Lighting is enabled.

airConditioner.title: Air Conditioner Temperature Limits
airConditioner.description: Optional HomeKit temperature range override for Wi-Fi air conditioners. Values are always Celsius; Home app converts to Fahrenheit automatically for users using °F.

minTemperature.title: Minimum temperature (°C)
minTemperature.description: Lowest setpoint exposed to HomeKit. Common values are 16 or 17. Leave empty to use Tuya schema.

maxTemperature.title: Maximum temperature (°C)
maxTemperature.description: Highest setpoint exposed to HomeKit. Common value is 31. Leave empty to use Tuya schema.

temperatureStep.title: Temperature step (°C)
temperatureStep.description: Set to 1 to suppress 0.5 °C steps. Values are Celsius even when Home app displays Fahrenheit.

petFeeder.title: Smart Pet Feeder Options
petFeeder.description: Optional settings for detected Tuya pet feeders only. The plugin exposes a refined HomeKit Valve-style Feed Now control, Quick Feed switch, optional Slow Feed switch, feeding-state sensor, and battery when supported.

manualFeedAmount.title: Manual feed amount
manualFeedAmount.description: Portions sent when the Valve-style Feed Now control is activated.

exposeSlowFeed.title: Expose Slow Feed switch
exposeSlowFeed.description: Expose slow_feed as a HomeKit switch when the device supports it.

alarm.title: Alarm Options
alarm.description: Optional extra switches for Tuya alarm panels. The main alarm is exposed as a HomeKit Security System when master_mode is available.

windowCovering.title: Blind / Window Covering Options
windowCovering.description: Optional settings for Tuya blinds, curtains and window coverings. Use invertPosition when Tuya reports 100 as closed instead of open. Use reverseControl when open/close movement commands are physically reversed.

invertPosition.title: Invert position 0/100
invertPosition.description: Enable when Tuya percentage meaning is reversed. HomeKit requires 0 = closed and 100 = open; this maps Tuya 0 → HomeKit 100 and Tuya 100 → HomeKit 0.

reverseControl.title: Reverse open/close commands
reverseControl.description: Enable when dragging open in HomeKit makes the blind close, or dragging closed makes it open. This swaps Tuya open/close control commands without changing percentage meaning.

settleSeconds.title: External movement settle time
settleSeconds.description: Seconds after an open/close command from the Tuya app before Homebridge refreshes the device and forces HomeKit out of Opening/Closing if Tuya does not send a final position/stop event.

trustExternalControlState.title: Use Tuya app open/close as final state
trustExternalControlState.description: When enabled, an open/close command triggered from the Tuya app is treated as the semantic HomeKit target. This fixes motors whose Tuya percentage DPs report the opposite state during external app control.

channels.title: Per-channel blind options
channels.description: Optional advanced per-channel overrides keyed by HomeKit service subtype, for example control or control_2. Each channel can define invertPosition and/or reverseControl.

trustExternalControlState.title: Use Tuya app open/close as final state

travelSeconds.title: Estimated full travel time
travelSeconds.description: Approximate seconds for the blind/curtain to travel fully open-to-closed. Used only to estimate the partial position when tapping to stop and Tuya does not report live percent_state while moving.

estimatePositionOnStop.title: Estimate partial position when stopped
estimatePositionOnStop.description: When enabled, if Tuya does not report a live position while moving, Homebridge estimates the current partial position when you tap to stop so Apple Home does not remain stuck as Opening/Closing.

externalControlStateMode.title: Tuya app open/close state mapping
externalControlStateMode.description: How Homebridge interprets open/close events coming from the Tuya app. Normal is recommended for most devices: Tuya app open = HomeKit open. Use Reversed if Tuya app open still appears as Closing/Closed in Apple Home.

tapToStop.title: Tap while moving stops blind
tapToStop.description: When enabled, tapping the HomeKit blind tile while the blind is opening or closing sends the Tuya stop command and sets TargetPosition to the current position, avoiding endless Opening/Closing spinner.

doubleClickToClose.title: Partial-open double tap closes
doubleClickToClose.description: Best-effort helper for Apple Home: from a partial position, first tap continues opening; a very quick second tap tries to close instead. Apple Home may not always emit a second identical tap event.

travelSeconds.title: Estimated full travel time
travelSeconds.description: Approximate seconds for the blind/curtain to travel fully open-to-closed. Used only to estimate the partial position when tapping to stop and Tuya does not report live percent_state while moving.

estimatePositionOnStop.title: Estimate partial position when stopped
estimatePositionOnStop.description: When enabled, if Tuya does not report a live position while moving, Homebridge estimates the current partial position when you tap to stop so Apple Home does not remain stuck as Opening/Closing.

homeKitNameReimportToken.title: HomeKit name re-import token
homeKitNameReimportToken.description: Advanced. Apple Home can keep old cached service names such as Bathroom 1/2/3. Set or change this token once to force Tuya accessories to be re-imported into HomeKit using the service names currently shown in Homebridge Accessories. Leave blank normally. Changing it will make Apple Home see the accessories as new and may require moving them back to rooms/favorites/automations.
